verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud marketing names a built-in Grafana Assistant and Investigations as AI-powered capabilities, and promises natural-language understanding of production systems, so an in-product assistant exists. The pack has no documentation of what tasks it can carry out or how it acts on the user's behalf, and the evidence ties it to Grafana Cloud rather than self-hosted Grafana. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on assistant task delegation and actions (e.g., building dashboards or running investigations autonomously), confirmation of availability outside Cloud, independent or hands-on corroboration.
